title: Planar Graph Embedding Formalization for Euler Formula

problemStatement.formal: V - E + F = 2 for connected planar graphs. Every planar graph is 6-colorable.
problemStatement.plain: Formalize Euler's polyhedron formula and its consequences including edge bounds, non-planarity certificates, genus theory, and the Six Color Theorem.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: 60 theorems about Euler's formula and planar graph theory, all fully proved (0 sorries, 0 axioms).
